title: Sources: China told some local tech companies to temporarily halt purchase orders for Nvidia's H200 chips while officials deliberate on import conditions (Qianer Liu/The Information)
summary: Qianer Liu / The Information: Sources: China told some local tech companies to temporarily halt purchase orders for Nvidia's H200 chips while officials deliberate on import conditions — The Chinese government this week asked some tech companies to temporarily halt plans to buy Nvidia's H200 AI chips …
